test_policy.notes: First-year applicants may apply without SAT/ACT: guaranteed admission with a 2.8 GPA and college-prep coursework; 2.5-2.79 is reviewed individually. With scores, the standard is a 2.5 GPA plus SAT 960 or ACT 18. The international undergraduate pages do not mention SAT/ACT.

requirements.notes: International application fee is a non-refundable $30 (valid one year). Required: official secondary transcripts (the checklist says minimum 2.5 GPA on a 4.0 scale, the requirements page says 2.00), English proficiency scores or a waiver, financial affidavit with a bank statement showing one year of funding, and a passport copy. No I-20 is issued without official records. The page gives no year with the deadlines, so fall 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall term (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The checklist prints 'May 15 for Fall Admission / November 1 for Spring Admission' without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed (the spring 2028 deadline would be Nov. 1, 2027).

deadlines.label: Nursing (prelicensure BSN) direct-entry application, opens Oct. 1
deadlines.notes: Competitive, limited seats, needs a 3.75 high-school GPA; decisions by Jan. 31. Dates have no year on the page, so fall 2027 entry is assumed. Other pre-nursing students apply to the major by March 1 of freshman year.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived with 24 semester hours at a U.S. college, ELS Level 112 certificate, Language Company Level 9, Kaplan Proficiency Level, two consecutive years of study in an English-primary country within the past two years, or two terms of EAP Level 6 at SIU Carbondale CESL. Scores are valid two years. Conditional admission is possible for applicants who meet everything except the English requirement; they must then show English mastery to the Office of International Students and Scholars.

english.notes: Paper-based TOEFL 500 also accepted. The page gives no minimum on the new 1-6 TOEFL scale. EIU TOEFL code 1199.

aid.notes: New first-year and transfer international undergraduates are eligible for an International Scholar Award of $1,000 per fall and spring semester ($2,000/yr; up to $8,000 over four years for first-years) with no minimum GPA. An International Excellence Award assesses tuition at the in-state rate for undergraduates with a 3.5 GPA (4.0 scale) at admission. A competitive International Student Scholarship (partial tuition, 3.00 GPA, based on need and/or academic excellence) is also offered. EIU also charges a $230 international student fee per academic year.

majors.notes: Most students enter as pre-nursing and apply by March 1 of freshman year (2.75 prerequisite GPA, C or better in prerequisites). A limited direct-entry track admits high-school seniors with a 3.75 GPA.

sat.note: EIU's international pages list no SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.
